scope_constraints.applies_to: Pauli-X conjugation X rho(a, s, gamma) X == rho(-a, s, gamma) and sign-rectified CNOT pairing
scope_constraints.controls_included: Includes exact 2x2 density-matrix verification of X rho(theta, gamma) X == rho(-theta, gamma) and 100% d_2=0 branch alignment on {2, 6}^2 mod 8 (up from 50% without Pauli-X rectification).
scope_constraints.does_not_claim: Elimination of the Stage-2 syndrome coin flip d_2 in {0, 1} when combining two quantum wires
